notes: The companion notifier (the PRD's deferred growth feature): agent-room wait — a blocking CLI for the hosts' background-task machinery. All-rooms-of-the-Actor default with --room narrowing, per-cycle room re-enumeration (DM discovery mid-wait), cursor baseline read-only from the MCP adapter, hint-only output (never message bodies), deadline 300/600 s monotonic, ≤6 concurrent long-polls, one wait per installation (wait.lock 0600, pid-liveness reclaim), creates nothing. No server-side behavior change; the REL-3 qualification of v0.3.0 covers the unchanged server core. Honest scope stated in help/README/notes: wakes a LIVE host session only.
